newsitems.title: Patch #5: Minor Fixes and Improvements
newsitems.author: Scream_Wattson
newsitems.contents:
Operators,

We noticed many requests for a MID-MISSION SAVE SYSTEM, and Nick is working on this feature.

Since this will be a larger-scale update and will take a little more time to implement, we decided to release a small patch in the meantime addressing three minor issues.


[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3][hr][/hr]Version 1.0 (1622)

[b]FIXED:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Desktop cursor[/b] visible on the main menu
[*] [b]Colour Blind modes[/b] not applying
[/list]
[b]IMPROVED:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Reduced ghosting effects[/b] on the clock
[/list]
[i]Pevious patches: [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2950790/view/706654285854671357?l=english]Patch #4[/url]] • [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2950790/view/719038550989865822?l=polish]Patch #3[/url]] • [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2950790/view/719038550989865733?l=polish]Patch #2[/url]] • [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2950790/view/719038550989865485?l=polish]Patch #1[/url]][/i]


[h3][b]Roadmap, Reports & Resources[/b][/h3]
[hr][/hr]Remember, the first and most important place to stay connected with us has always been, and always will be, our [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url]. That’s where Nick runs the game’s open development on a daily basis, discuss what’s happening behind the scenes, and stay in touch with Operators directly. 

We also recommend checking our regularly updated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950790/discussions/0/604170759802194525/]FAQ[/url] thread on the Steam Community Hub, where you’ll find answers to the most frequently asked questions.

And if you’d like to share a suggestion, report a bug, or flag something that should be improved in the localisation, please head over to our dedicated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950790/discussions/0/588434161796238306/]Bug & Feedback Hub[/url], also here on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/650214560f8d32fce3c3a6eed0b214dbb80b44a2.png[/img]
As for what comes next, Nick is currently focused on the mentioned MID-MISSION SAVE SYSTEM that so many of you have requested. Then, starting August 24, gamescom begins. And both of us will be heading to Cologne. 

We highly recommend keeping an eye on our [url=https://linktr.ee/IRONNEST]socials[/url], because we’re planning to organize a small meet-up with you somewhere on site. And once we’re back, of course, we’ll continue improving IRON NEST and move forward with the additional Skirmish Modes, as outlined in the roadmap.


[h3][b]Once Again: Thank You[/b][/h3]
[hr][/hr]High Command’s Propaganda Division is running out of ways to communicate this, Operators. Your reviews, feedback, and support continue to go far beyond anything we ever expected.

We know some of you may wonder why we keep repeating this in almost every announcement, but we simply don’t know how not to. Nearly 10,000 reviews, with 98% of them positive, is something we never imagined we would see. Thank you for making this possible.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950790/IRON_NEST_Heavy_Turret_Simulator/
Every time we think the front has reached its limit, you push it even further.

GLORY TO THE OPERATORS!

Nick & Dominik

newsitems.title: IRON NEST IS NOW FULLY OPERATIONAL
newsitems.author: Scream_Wattson
newsitems.contents:
[i]Operators.

After thousands of design decisions, hundreds of sleepless nights, countless cups of coffee that legally qualified as industrial solvents…[/i]

[h3][b]HIGH COMMAND CONFIRMS: IRON NEST IS FULLY OPERATIONAL[/b][/h3]

To celebrate the launch, we've [b]🔴 increased the release discount from 20% to 25% 🔴[/b]. Not because some marketing spreadsheet told us to, but because this project was never ours alone.

[previewyoutube=35hAxxPml2E;full][/previewyoutube]
When we started making IRON NEST, there wasn't an army behind us. It was just us. Then a handful of people on [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url] somehow looked at this strange little giant turret game and decided: "yeah... let's see where this goes."

[hr][/hr]
You kept showing up. You brought your friends into the ranks. You rallied Content Creators to our cause. You shared your stories, screenshots, clips, ridiculous strategies, and bug reports that occasionally resembled "minor and entirely acceptable casualties".

Then, seemingly out of nowhere, that tiny [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url] server grew into a headquarters for 70,000 loyal Operators. We’ve been in a year-long mad rush, so it will take quite some time until we fully grasp the reality of it all. We never dreamed of this. We still don't fully understand how this happened.

What we _do_ understand is that [b]without you, this game would never have become what it is today[/b]. Not even close. So making the game a little cheaper on day one for everyone who has been waiting is the smallest "thank you" we could think of. Truthfully, this will likely be the deepest discount for quite some time. It felt like the right way to celebrate the launch.

We've poured everything we had into IRON NEST. People say that all the time, we know. But we genuinely have. Late nights became early mornings, weekends quietly disappeared. Friends and family got far fewer sightings of us than they deserved. We hope that when they look at IRON NEST and the incredible community it has brought together, they'll feel it was worth sharing us with everyone else for a little while.

Because we'd do it all again. [b]No matter what happens from today onward… This has already been the adventure of our lives.[/b]

[hr][/hr][h3]
[b]POST-LAUNCH ROADMAP[/b][/h3]

So, does High Command rest? Negative. We reviewed our own request for vacation. And... It was denied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/650214560f8d32fce3c3a6eed0b214dbb80b44a2.png[/img]
More content. More missions. More skirmish modes. More features. More music. High Command knows what you're about to ask, so let's save everyone some time:

[b]🔴 YES. Eventually... MULTIPLAYER. 🔴[/b]

And somewhere along the way, all of this will culminate in a proper expansion.

[i]***You can find answers about console ports, VR, and other frequently asked questions in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950790/discussions/0/604170759802194525/]this thread[/url].[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]FINAL ORDERS[/b][/h3]

High Command has one request: if IRON NEST has earned your approval, consider leaving an honest review on Steam. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url], recruit a fellow Operator, or share the machine with your household through Steam Family Sharing. Every recommendation, every conversation, and every single Operator could tip the scales of victory in our favor. And if you encountered a bug, localization issue, or have an idea for what comes next? Submit your field report through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950790/discussions/0/588434161796238306/]HUB // Reports, Feedback & Localization[/url].

[hr][/hr]
[i]The hatches are sealed.
The engines are running.
The guns are loaded.[/i]

High Command has issued the order.

[b]🔴 THE FINAL OFFENSIVE BEGINS NOW. 🔴[/b]

[i]GLORY TO THE OPERATORS.

Nick & Dominik[/i]

Your screenshot. Your name. On the IRON NEST Steam Store page.

Since IRON NEST stands on the strength of its Operators, we decided [b]there is no better place for your work than the official Steam Store page[/b].

That is why, to [b]celebrate Steam Next Fest together[/b] with you, High Command has authorized a small [b]Screenshot Operation[/b].

[h3]🔻 How to participate / [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950790/discussions/0/567037624436565719/]submit[/url] your screenshot:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Open the Steam app

[*] In the top-left corner, go to:

[b]Steam > Settings > In Game > Screenshots[/b]

Check which key is assigned to "Take a screenshot"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/efcc146959207762746ad721dcf7be9774be3e84.png[/img] [*] Launch the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4300500/IRON_NEST_Heavy_Turret_Simulator_Demo/]IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator Demo[/url][/b] and [b]make a screenshot[/b]

Make sure the visibility is set to Public

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/b9df2393532c2743bdaa680a0466932cc3095a2e.png[/img]
[*] Return to this official [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950790/discussions/0/567037624436565719/]Steam submission thread[/url] and post the link to your screenshot.

[url=https:https://ironnest-game.com/Leaderboard][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/9e3f68fa3e3861d0a12d0e190a28c7edc7194124.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]Available commands:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*][b]/leaderboard challenge[/b] - Check the current Top 20 scores on the Challenge Mode leaderboard.
[*][b]/leaderboard chill[/b] - check the current Top 20 Operators by total confirmed kills

[*][b]/leaderboard mechill[/b] - check your own total confirmed kills

[*][b]/missions mymedals[/b] - check your medals

[h2]📋 Frontline Report 📋[/h2]

And now, Operators... silence all transmitters for a moment, because this message must be heard clearly:

[h3]THANK YOU! From the bottom of our hearts.[/h3]

For everything you have done for us...

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4300500/IRON_NEST_Heavy_Turret_Simulator_Demo/]IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator Demo[/url] is currently standing at Overwhelmingly Positive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/9399eddb1af1bcf7f76e2673a6679b8fbc5beb8c.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]2.8 MILLION[/b] shots fired

And the machine keeps counting...[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]🚨 Steam Next Fest is still underway until [b]June 22[/b] 🚨[/h3]

Hold the line, Operator. Castile needs you on the Steam Next Fest front.

[quote]Planned to fire two shells? Fire fifteen.

Leaving to make coffee? Keep the engine running.

Every minute aboard matters.[/quote]
But before this transmission ends...

As we have said many times before: if there were awards for the communities built around games, IRON NEST would take every single one this year.

Nick & Dominik

newsitems.title: 𝐓𝐇𝐀𝐍𝐊 𝐘𝐎𝐔
newsitems.author: Scream_Wattson [TTV]
newsitems.contents:
Nick and I have tried to find the right words to properly thank each and every one of you, yet [b]no message could ever fully capture what your support means to us[/b] or how deeply it has shaped the growth of the NEST. The proper moment for that recognition will come in the game’s credits... and not only for a select few. As promised, every member of [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url] who stands with us on launch day will be honored there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/06634a98c18c00b2a521380f1f2c40a2bdb938f5.png[/img]
I still remember how, just four months ago, I was writing on Reddit about a Steamworks bug [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/IndieDev/comments/1p69ycx/quarter_milion_wishlists/](here is the post)[/url]. At the time, around 20-30 thousand of you were already with us, and then Steamworks suddenly displayed 230 thousand instead. Back then, [b]that number felt completely unreal[/b]. 

The question Nick and I asked each other that day: “What if?”... the only thing that followed was laughter, because it all felt far too impossible to believe. I truly wish I had recorded that moment...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/45ebd32ecc2d3e0710e978b58b3b5d8fe7a47877.png[/img]
On February 17... more than 10,000 of you joined our ranks in a single day, and everything that followed was pure madness. That rollercoaster carried us all the way to where we stand today: among the top [b]#225 most wishlisted games[/b] on Steam. There was a moment when so many of you were answering the call that we even broke into the top 100 fastest-growing games on Steam.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]🎪 [b]NEST FEST, February 23 to March 2[/b] (our answer to Steam Next Fest) 🎪[/h3]

That operation taught us far more than how not to run playtests. Above all else, it proved to us once again that we are standing beside a truly exceptional community.

The way you supported one another, the patience you showed under pressure, your participation in the contests, and the effort so many of you put into spreading the word of IRON NEST and creating content around the event are only a few examples. [b]To be entrusted with a force like this is a privilege we are not even sure we deserve, but one we carry with gratitude every single day[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/888e6d73942cc750e32440e779e3e5a452621763.png[/img]

I will not pretend those tests were meant to be anything more than small-scale stress trials, focused on the core mechanics, the tutorial, and the most fundamental parts of the game. The fact that [b]nearly 10,000 of you answered the call was crazy[/b]. I am sorry for the moments when the key distribution bots broke down, but I want you to know this: for a brief moment, you overwhelmed Ghostbot’s servers through sheer force of mobilization. 

There is probably no greater reward for a developer than seeing so many people that the bot itself could not withstand it.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🎙 [b]Live Event: NEST FEST Summary + FAQ[/b] 🎙[/h2]

In response to your requests, we want to prepare an official NEST FEST recap for you. We want to share both the [b]development perspective [/b]and the lessons we took from the event, as well as what we [b]plan to do next[/b] based on your gathered feedback. Alongside that, we will also host a [b]live FAQ session[/b] where on voice chat you will be able to ask us questions directly, and we will answer them in real time.

[h3][b]Friday, April 10, 2026, at 21:00 (CEST) on our [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url].[/b][/h3]

[i]Do not worry. We plan to record the entire meeting and upload it to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@IRONNESTgame]YouTube[/url] channel shortly after the event, so even if you already have plans that day, you will still be able to catch up and hear the full recap.[/i]

[b]Direct Link to the Discord event:[/b] https://discord.com/events/1410998498094092339/1489934001052323931

[hr][/hr]
If you want to help us push this machine even further, keep the signal alive. Support [url=https://linktr.ee/IRONNEST]our posts[/url], share them where you can, talk about IRON NEST, create content around it, and if you have a way to reach press or influencers who may want to hear about the project, we would be truly grateful for that support too. Every action matters. [b]Every voice strengthens the campaign[/b]. And every Operator standing with us helps carry IRON NEST forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/b0afeaea563a821583439e2166d2fba91d21baa7.png[/img]
And in return, we can make you one promise: if life grants us enough time, we will keep building for you. Not only IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator, but future projects set in the IRON NEST universe as well. As long as we are here, and as long as this machine endures, we will keep doing our best to give you more worlds, more stories, and [b]more reasons to march with us[/b].

[hr][/hr]
[h3]We have lived with this project for so long, and poured so much of ourselves into it, that it has become something far greater than just a game to us.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/0a911b06c1174de1277b06c4488d647b5343489c.png[/img]
[h3]This project means more to us than anything, and it will stay with us forever.[/h3]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]⚠️ Important ⚠️[/h3]
[list]
[*] The [b]public demo[/b] will deploy [b]during Steam Next Fest in June[/b]
[*] The [b]official release date[/b] will be [b]revealed during Steam Next Fest[/b] (mid-2026)
[*] All [b]major console ports[/b] are already [b]confirmed[/b]
[*] We are securing the final details and should [b]soon[/b] be ready to officially confirm the [b]VR port[/b]
[*] [b]Internal playtests[/b] remain active on our [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url]
[/list]

newsitems.contents:
[h3][b]Who would've expected a niche indie artillery game to grow at this pace[/b][/h3]
[hr][/hr][b]Greetings, Operators![/b]

It's hard to believe it's already been[b] three/four months since we first revealed our project[/b] on Steam. Time is moving so fast it sometimes feels like it all started just a week ago... Back then, Nick and I thought we'd post a devlog every 1K wishlists ➙ roughly once every two months. Not only did we miss the first one by about five thousand… now, as we're writing the second devlog, [b]we've just crossed 20,000![/b]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/2a5136f1567646cf1e3721dcfb3bcf3d432f3a1c.png[/img][hr][/hr][i]Commissar, record their names. 
Mark every recruit who was among the first to summon the courage and answer the call to mobilization.

They stood when others hesitated. 
They stepped forward when silence was safer.

Glory to them.
Glory to the sons.
Glory to the fathers.
Glory to the brothers who stand here united.

~ High Command[/i]
[hr][/hr][b]★★★ Previously, I promised that this devlog would be more technical and since I mainly handle marketing, Nick has prepared something for you! ★★★ [/b][hr][/hr]
[h3][b]IRON NEST - Mission Loop: From Concept to Gameplay & Replayability
[/b][/h3]

[hr][/hr][b]Nick:[/b] When I first started prototyping IRON NEST, [spoiler](Which was the 5th "big gun" prototype game I made this summer and the 1st one, which was not a hot pile of poop)[/spoiler] [b]I wanted missions to feel grounded[/b], like you're actually running an artillery gun, not just ticking off objectives.

So instead of a "go here, shoot this" checklist, [b]I'm building everything around a living map[/b]: bearings, distances, impact points, and intel all stack together so you can piece together what's happening out there, even though you're stuck inside the turret.

I could've gone with fixed target spots and scripted situations, but that would've murdered replayability, and [b]replayability is a huge pillar of IRON NEST[/b]. Honestly because I need to playtest it for 1000s of hours, and I would go insane replaying the same missions that many times. 
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/a91bcbc0d61135db320cf5fda8c18117744018c3.png[/img][hr][/hr][b]The first real headache was honestly just… space[/b]. Unity's UI has a bunch of different coordinate modes, and they all have slightly different opinions on where "here" actually is.

My solution ended up being pretty simple: I decided to[b] base the whole map system on the local space of a world-space UI[/b].

[b]That means the map is basically a flat 2D "plane" in the world[/b], and I can treat it like real space: [b]1 Unity unit = 1km[/b]. Everything on the map: targets, impacts, recon markers, etc. lives on that same plane, so all bearings and distances come straight from that. I could move that plane around, rotate it, scale it, etc. and the system still works.
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/536d67604f42f59a0cdfc4b78cc9fc40d9f0585b.png[/img][hr][/hr][b]Next up was figuring out rules and outcomes[/b]. Different shell types, sometimes a target may need a single hit, sometimes a full salvo, plus all the Success / Failure / Bonus stuff… and I really didn't want that turning into a giant pile of if-statements.

[b]So I kept it data-driven[/b].

[b]Each target/location has a small list of rules[/b] (my ShellEffectRules) that say, this shell type + this many hits = this result. Then when a shell lands, the location checks the rules and decides what that impact actually means: blow something up, disable a system, give you credit, trigger visuals, whatever.

The nice part is the "decision" happens right at the impact, and everything else just reacts to it. [b]Clean cause-and-effect, [strike]no[/strike] less hardcoded spaghetti.[/b]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/afa96f328689f20a91c7bda169bac704d5629694.png[/img][hr][/hr][b]Then I moved on to intel[/b]. Stuff like bearing lines (083°), distance readouts (1.25 km), grid coordinates  (B9 4:2), etc…

Because every target/ally/enemy token is being resolved live inside the same shared map space, [b]I'm not locked into fixed positions or scripted moments[/b]. I can set up a situation, let the pieces land where they land, and the map intel still makes sense. The mission can evolve, i.e. units moving, dying, arriving, and every new bit of intel can react to it.
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/45ac7e23b031fd8b67e21516b40bcffe7b80d032.png[/img][hr][/hr][b]This is where the replayability really starts to show up.[/b]

[b]Missions aren't locked to one "correct" layout[/b]. Spawn zones can pick different positions, stuff can show up mid-mission, and the intel you get is generated from what's actually happening right now.

[b]So even with the same mission template, you can end up with a different map setup[/b]. And the same shot can lead to different followup intel depending on who's still alive, what recon/correction level you're working with, and what shells you're using.
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/203337fb1a5fd5cd482b127ecaf73a1dd5dbbd8e.png[/img][hr][/hr][h3][b]Once the loop clicked, the rest fell into place:[/b][/h3][p]
[b]Impacts are the single source of truth[/b]. When a shell lands, anything inside the blast radius checks its shell rules and decides what happens: damage, rewards, disabling systems, whatever that location is set up to do.

[b]Intel comes in with a rhythm[/b]. I've got a queued, typewriter-style printer that feeds you info through triggers (like entering an area), so stuff doesn't just instantly pop onto the UI. It shows up when it makes sense in the moment.

From the player's side, it ends up feeling coherent but still unpredictable. [b]You do something and the world reacts[/b]. Bearings actually point where they should. Distances line up.  Unit locations are only visually revealed when recon photographs overlap with their actual positions. And the whole narration / intel flow keeps the right cadence even when the mission layout and outcomes change run to run.[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/1bc4641566de43edaaf06c90557c53136298a126.png[/img][hr][/hr][h3][b]Why not pre-script everything?[/b] [/h3][p]
[b]It's just more fun to play.[/b]
Because the map is reacting to what's actually happening, you're not just following a memorized routine. You're making a plan, taking a shot, reading the results, adjusting, and watching the situation change. When the bearings and distances line up and the intel updates at the right time, it feels like you're doing real work, not just solving a pre-made puzzle.

[b]It's also way more fun to build.[/b]
Honestly, I don't want to keep replaying the exact same version of a puzzle I already know the answer to. With this setup, I can make a scenario system, hit play, and get surprised too, which makes testing and iterating way more enjoyable (and at the end of the day, having fun making this game is really important to me, call my shelfish).[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/f4136a405f0955384d43b997bf25d8d15ecdb582.png[/img][hr][/hr][h3][b]Now that the map / intel loop is finally behaving, I can shift focus to the stuff that'll really make the game feel alive:[/b][/h3]

[olist][*][p] [b]Finishing the internal 3D turret environment,  getting the space feeling right, readable, and nice to operate in.[/b]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Adding SFX,  all the clunks, hisses, hydraulics, printer chatter, shell handling… basically the "this machine is real" layer.[/b]
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Expanding the mission system so it can generate more dynamic little skirmishes between friendly and hostile units.[/b]
[/p][/*][/olist]Like having an actual front line of allied + hostile units, where if you punch a hole in something, your allies will try to push through and take ground, and the whole mission shifts around that.

[b]IRON NEST started with a pretty simple goal: Make big gun go booom.[/b] But that ended up turning into this nice little artillery fire command simulation where the player needs to build fire missions out of positions, bearings, distances, and reference points, and make sure the intel all agrees or risk war crimes.

[b]Building Iron Nest: Heavy tourette's  simulator is not flashy, but it's honest work. [/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]★★★ Operational Summary ★★★[/b][/h3]

[hr][/hr][b]Dominik:[/b] To formally close this devlog... [b]I wouldn't be myself if I didn't thank you once again[/b]. For months now, you've stood with us across every front: [url=https://www.instagram.com/ironnestgame/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@IRONNESTgame]YouTube[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url]... Your support fuels this operation, and it does not go unnoticed... [hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/d9f3b769ee7775aeffff909aee4fa1776ddb3fed.png[/img][hr][/hr][b]As promised: every Operator present on [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url] at the moment of release will be recorded in the credits.[/b] Your name will be bound to the machine for eternity.

Operational roadmap is as follows:
[list]
[*] [b]Playtests[/b] ➙ on [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url]
[*] Steam Next Fest (February) ➙ [b]Demo[/b] deployment
[*] Mid-2026 ➙ full [b]PC release[/b]
[*] Post-PC launch ➙ [b]ports to all major consoles[/b] (VR remains under active consideration)
[*] Next phase ➙ a new project built on the foundations of IRON NEST, but this time [b]multiplayer[/b] (co-op confirmed, PvP under evaluation)
[/list][i]Until next time, Operators.
A hive mind without its hive is nothing... just as we are nothing without you.

Nick & Dominik[/i]

[i]PS: Merry Christmas from IRON NEST.
Stay warm. Hold the line.[/i]

🎄💥🎁💣

newsitems.author: Scream_Wattson [TTV]
newsitems.contents:
[i]I honestly don’t even know how we should start this devlog… Should we begin with the hundredth "thank you" to everyone who clicked that magical "wishlist" button on Steam? Or maybe with an apology for not communicating with you as often as we'd like to?[/i]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/c2cc2133a037d3a4f6540997fbd8220e35c9711e.gif[/img][hr][/hr][h3]✯ I think it wouldn’t hurt to start with a little backstory! ✯[/h3]

[b]There are just two of us working on this project[/b]. From the very beginning ➙ when we were still shaping the concept and setting up our collaboration, we agreed that we didn’t want any second-party studios or publishers involved = we’re doing everything from A to Z, just the two of us... Even though this is our first project together, it’s [b]not the first game either of us has worked on[/b]. We both bring industry experience from different companies (over 20 years combined) so we know that in 2025, a developer who wants to self-publish has to be a programmer, an artist, and… surprise, surprise! ➙ An influencer / marketer as well!
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/0dc43e3fd16f30c6bd0ea2651a8725013fbd4723.png[/img][hr][/hr]Following that mindset, we (TBH Nick did) recently decided that IRON NEST was finally ready to be shown publicly... [b]We posted our first short[/b] [b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ironnestgame/video/7560481645401345302]clips on TikTok[/url][/b] ➙ the channels were clunky, the BIOs unfinished, and we had exactly "0" followers... But what happened under those short videos… Is something we honestly can’t even put into words...
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/53c6a2a4ce51d4c2c75f99d3d056805f3d531215.png[/img][hr][/hr][h3]✯ BOOM! 💥 IRON NEST just exploded! ✯[/h3]

[i]Some kind robot in charge of the algorithm decided to bless us with an insane amount of reach ➙ Disclaimer: we’d like to thank that kind robot from the bottom of our hearts![/i]

Back to the IRON NEST... That’s when it all began... (not that we’re complaining!) Steam wishlist started growing by around 1,500 people per day, and our [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url] (which had just the two of us) suddenly hit over 100 members in a single week! As I'm writing this devlog, [b]we’re sitting at 6,846 wishlists and 288 [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url] members[/b]! FYI ➙ We’re insannnnnnely happy that this project (born out of pure passion) resonated with you, because we’ve both been obsessed with artillery, interwar machinery, and dieselpunk worlds since forever = [b]seeing this kind of buzz around our project gives us an extra boost[/b]!
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/712f0317e758b0bc67a747188f3c5071c2a871ec.png[/img][hr][/hr][h3]✯ We’ve found ourselves in the place we’ve always wanted to be! ✯[/h3] 

[i]And it happened so fast it literally blew our fuses... Even though neither of us is capable of maintaining any kind of healthy work-life balance, pulling a ridiculous amount of overtime, there’s still never enough coffee in the machine to keep up with everything...[/i]

As many of you already know (we even mention it on our Steam Store Page), [b]one of our main inspirations is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956040/PVKK_Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant/]PVKK by Bipinbits[/url][/b] = if you’re going to aim high, aim so high you run out of oxygen, right?! Here's another small disclaimer ➙ let me paste one of the answers from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950790/discussions/0/604170759802194525/]FAQ[/url] we’ve been putting together with Nick recently.

[quote=FAQ][i][b]Q: Is it inspired by PVKK?[/b]
We both have big cannons? Sure... We both have fully manual control? Absolutely... But what you do with the cannon in IRON NEST is entirely different! We're huge fans of PVKK and, YES - it definitely inspired us. But our core gameplay loop revolves around ground-based artillery, which brings a completely different setup, mechanics, and challenges compared to an orbital gun![/i][/quote]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2956040/PVKK_Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant/ [hr][/hr][b]Since we’ve:[/b]
[list]
[*] taken on something equally ambitious; ⤴️
[*] preparing to release the [b]Demo during February’s Steam Next Fest[/b] (in just 3 months!); 
[*] scheduled the [b]full version[/b] (NO Early Access!) for [b]mid-2026[/b];
[*] running [b]playtests[/b] all the way until launch;
[*] been handling all the marketing ourselves; [/list] Sometimes we don’t have as much time for communication as we’d like to and that’s exactly [b]where we’re asking for your help[/b]!
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/67aa56fae6910ef9afa36aaf1228e1aa83a92a13.png[/img][hr][/hr][b]Our top priority is development = delivering a project that’s not just "okay"[/b], but one that meets and exceeds the expectations we’ve built through our steam page and short videos. But since it turns out there are people whose autism this also tickles just like ours, we also want to reach everyone who shares our passion and that’s where we need your help! If it’s not too much to ask, [b]spread the religion of IRON NEST across the corners of the internet[/b] (to bring even more people of "our kind" here), and we promise... won’t let you down!
[hr][/hr][b]Examples of how you can help us:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ask questions & leave comments[/b] on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2950790/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url];
[*] [b]Follow IRON NEST [/b][url=https://linktr.ee/IRONNEST]social media[/url] ➙ like, comment & repost our updates; 
[i](especially on X... the algorithm there doesn’t seem to like us very much)[/i]
[*] [b]Share info about IRON NEST[/b] on Reddits, Facebook groups, YouTube comments ➙ anywhere;
[i](or let us know where you think we should reach out...)[/i]
[*] If you're a influencer (content creator), know someone who is, or write for a gaming newsletter... reach out to us or recommend us to your friend: [b]info@ironnestgame.com[/b];
[i](we’ll be super grateful for any kind of coverage)[/i]
[*] [b]Join us on[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url] & invite your friends so we can communicate with you more easily;
[i](FYI ➙ everyone who stays with us on Discord until the game’s release will be added to the game credits + playtests are ongoing)[/i]
[*] Or tell us what we should be doing! [/list] [hr][/hr]PS: Once again, thank you for this amazing month... we're not slowing down! [b]The next devlogs will be more focused, diving into specific gameplay elements and behind-the-scenes insights[/b]. ***And if you can’t wait, hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url]! The channels where we discuss development are open to the community, so you can follow everything as it happens + take part in the playtests.
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45758348/d79e7c80824b33f9ac120f9d5c723dc131f26025.png[/img][hr][/hr][i]We tried recording this devlog as a video, but every single time we were so exhausted that it turned out like total crap... We’ll try again a few more times in the future, so keep your fingers crossed![/i]

Nick & Dominik

The updated page will most likely go live alongside the trailer and the demo, around the time of the Next Fest, where we plan to release the demo (pssst... there are constant development leaks popping up on [url=https://discord.gg/E92DaqgnZv]Discord[/url])![/i]
